lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb12Nd4Br24 (reduced formula Rb3NdBr6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Nd and Rb centers, each coordinated by six Br neighbors, alongside a close-packed-like 12-neighbor Br environment and a 12-neighbor Rb environment. Corner-sharing between Nd and Rb octahedra and face-sharing between Rb polyhedra are observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
